title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
statement: Given an array nums of positive integers and a positive integer target, return the shortest length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least target. Return 0 when no such subarray exists.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,3] reaches 7 with the shortest length.
No contiguous subarray reaches the target.

python.display_signature: def minSubArrayLen(self, target: int, nums: list[int]) -> int
